purpose: Independent chemistry and electron-count development evidence before speed work
model: SpinNumberState with exact number and total-spin labels, channels=2
projection: Complete stated AO basis, no frozen core or active orbital projection
input_orbitals: One bounded CUDA Hartree-Fock determinant; no retries if unconverged
objective: Actual molecular Hamiltonian Rayleigh quotient; no reference-energy loss
assessment: Report every case, number, spin, variational sign, reference retention, maximum error and balanced bond-stretch contrasts. No replacements, no label-driven seed/rank/iteration changes.
reference: New CUDA exact diagonalization in the same complete minimal basis, performed after optimization
limitations: Not a complete-basis chemical accuracy result
Per-system variational optimization, not an amortized learned energy predictor
Unconstrained molecular-state test does not establish an XC functional
Procedural new cases, not a sequestered benchmark
